posts.name: silopolis
posts.cooked:
Hey all, 

I'm waiting as patiently as I can for the RPG core book, but I'm feeling a little concerned about the fact that the Kickstarter hasn't happened yet... or even been announced, as far as I can tell. Is there any information around as to when we can expect the KS to happen?

I mean, we have all sorts of "Starter kit" stuff to do, but if my players love it and want to make their own characters, we're poop out of luck. I find that the RPG stuff I've backed in the past ship at least 6 months, if not a year, after their Kickstarter is done. So are we really looking at late 2019 before we can really use this system for our own games?

posts.name: rickjonzz
posts.cooked:
IIRC, when they first said on the podcast that the kickstarter was going to be moved to January that the kickstarter being moved wasn't affecting the production schedule of the book. I took it to mean that around the time the kickstarter ended that the pdf would be ready. Presumably they will need the kickstarter to complete to know how many copies they need to print, and that number affects how long it'll take to go from pdf-ready to physical copies in our greedy little hands. 

I think they said that backers should get something as soon as the kickstarter ends, but I'd have to search through the podcast to find it. (Possibly the final pdf, possibly a pre-release pdf that's not quite ready. A lot of RPG kickstarters send out a pdf that doesn't have all the art, or the index isn't finished, of the pdf doesn't have all the fancy hyperlink bookmarks, etc.)

posts.name: rickjonzz
posts.cooked: They broadcast 2 mini-campaigns where folks played original characters. There's a step by step process, and you have the option to roll randomly or pick items at each step. It's very simple. You pick/roll what you were before becoming a superhero (nerdy high school kid, billionaire genius philanthropist, etc) which determines some of your Qualities. Then you pick/roll an origin (bitten by radioactive spider, struck by lightning during a particle accelerator accident) and archetype (speedster, blaster, shapechanger) which determine what sort of powers (and some more Qualities) you have. If you check GTG's YouTube page, you can see both campaigns character creation episodes.
